menu.title: A5 Miyazaki Wagyu Strip
menu.description: 6oz of authentic Japanese A5 wagyu, seared on cherrywood. Served with shaved black truffles, smoked flake salt, and a sweet aged soy reduction.

menu.title: Glazed Chilean Sea Bass
menu.description: Pan-roasted sea bass fillet in a caramelized white miso infusion. Served over baby bok choy and ginger-scented forbidden black rice.

menu.title: Black Truffle Tagliolini
menu.description: House-crafted egg pasta tossed in a rich butter emulsion, loaded with fresh hand-shaved Italian summer truffles and 24-month aged Parmigiano-Reggiano.

menu.title: Smoked Rosemary Old Fashioned
menu.description: Bespoke small-batch bourbon stirred with orange bitters and house-crafted maple syrup, served over a clear hand-cut ice sphere, smoked tableside with fresh rosemary.

menu.title: Neon Velvet Cocktail
menu.description: Empress gin shaken with fresh lavender nectar, yuzu juice, and elderflower liqueur, topped with a glowing tonic float that shifts colors under blacklight.

menu.title: Grand Cru Obsidian Martini
menu.description: Ultra-premium vodka infused with activated coconut charcoal and dry vermouth, served in a gold-rimmed coupe with a cocktail onion and pearl dust.

menu.title: Elysium Gold Leaf Fondant
menu.description: Rich Belgian dark chocolate cake with a molten core of white chocolate ganache, draped in 24k edible gold leaf and paired with house-spun vanilla bean ice cream.

menu.title: Deconstructed Matcha Soufflé
menu.description: Light and airy organic Uji matcha soufflé served with hot salted caramel sauce and fresh raspberries.

events.title: DJ Sasha & John Digweed – Echoes of Progress
events.description: An exclusive extended 4-hour progressive house journey by the absolute legendary pioneers of electronic music. Immersive structural lighting grids and audio-visual setups.

events.title: Neon Syndicate feat. DJ Blackout
events.description: Prepare for an audio-visual trip into deep industrial tech-house. Immersive laser tunnels, heavy subbass, and raw techno frequencies from midnight onwards.

events.title: Jazz & Caviar Lounge: The Gatsby Session
events.description: Enjoy a sophisticated dining ambiance in our restaurant room with live improvisational jazz by the Marcus Miller Trio. Special pricing on Dom Pérignon and caviar flights.

reservations.name: Christian Bale
reservations.specialRequests: Needs utmost privacy. Ordering 2 bottles of Dom Pérignon Brut Rose. Ensure strict security entry.

reservations.name: Sophia Loren
reservations.specialRequests: Prefer a quiet table near the flower installation. Celebrating an anniversary.

testimonials.name: Alexander Sinclair
testimonials.quote: Elysium is a complete sensory masterclass. Starting our night with the Wagyu Ribeye and transitioning directly into the high-tech Funktion-One dance arena was absolutely flawless.

testimonials.name: Isabella Sterling
testimonials.quote: The food displays a culinary integrity rarely seen in nightlife establishments. The Black Truffle Tagliolini is exceptional, and their cocktail mixology is pure sensory magic.

settings.restaurantAbout: Elysium's restaurant room celebrates wood-fired fine cuisine. We combine custom imported A5 beef cuts with hand-picked organic elements. Guided by our award-winning culinary staff, each dish is a bespoke experience of textures, scents, and flavors, providing a refined gateway to the evening.
settings.clubAbout: As the moon rises, Elysium's sound theater comes alive. Featuring a professional Funktion-One sound system, dynamic kinetic laser rigs, and custom visuals, we host world-class electronic music legends and premium selectors, crafting a nightlife sanctuary that breathes rhythm.
settings.seoDescription: Elysium Lounge & Club - Premium dining and high-end nightlife sanctuary in South Beach, Miami. Wood-fired steaks, artisan cocktails, and world-class house and techno events.
